mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by more than 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY decline > 2% and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially in a high-inflation environment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, CPIAUCSL > 200, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines MoM for 2 consecutive months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate sales (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline YoY
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline YoY, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 200, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 200, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
